s.how: Pop 120g kernels. Cook 60g butter until golden and nutty, then stir in 1 tsp smoked paprika, a pinch of chipotle powder and fine salt. Toss through the popcorn and fill striped paper bags.

s.note: Jupiter's Claim, the western theme park out in the desert
s.how: Fry 150g diced bacon and 1 onion in a cast-iron pot until golden. Add 2 cans drained pinto beans, 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, 2 tbsp molasses, 2 tbsp tomato paste and 250ml water. Simmer 30 minutes until thick and smoky, and serve in tin cups.

m.note: the family horse ranch in California
m.how: Rub a 1.2kg rump cap with salt, pepper and 3 crushed garlic cloves. Grill over coals, fat side first, until 54C inside and rest 10 minutes. Warm 2 tins pinto beans. Dice 3 tomatoes with onion, coriander and lime for salsa. Slice and serve.

w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate with 100g butter, beat in 150g brown sugar and 1 egg, then 180g flour. Bake 16 small rounds at 175C for 9 minutes. Sandwich pairs with a marshmallow each, warm 1 minute to melt, then roll the edges in silver sprinkles.

d.how: Blend 1kg watermelon flesh with the juice of 2 limes and 2 tbsp sugar. Strain into a jug, add 250ml cold water and serve over ice with mint.
